title: Yapily Consent
description: Consent detailing the requested authorisation from a user to a specific `Institution`.

applicationUserId.description: __Conditional__. The user-friendly reference to the `User` that will authorise the authorisation request. If a `User` with the specified `applicationUserId` exists, it will be used otherwise, a new `User` with the specified `applicationUserId` will be created and used. Either the `userUuid` or `applicationUserId` must be provided.

institutionId.description: __Mandatory__. The `Institution` the authorisation request is sent to.

status.description: Current status of the embedded authorisation request in code form.

createdAt.description: Date and time of when the consent was created.

transactionFrom.description: When performing a transaction query using the consent, this is the earliest date of transaction records that can be retrieved.

transactionTo.description: When performing a transaction query using the consent, this is the latest date of transaction records that can be retrieved.

expiresAt.description: Date and time of when the authorisation will expire by. Reauthorisation will be needed to retain access.

featureScope.description: The set of features that the consent will provide access to.

items.description:
Used to describe what functions are supported by the associated `Institution`.        

For more information on each feature, see the following links:        

- [Financial Data Features](/data/financial-data-resources/financial-data-features)
- [Payments Features](/payments/payment-resources/payment-features)

consentToken.description: Represents the authorisation to gain access to the requested features. Required to access account information or make a payment request.

state.description: Correlation ID used with the `Institution` during the authorisation process.

authorizedAt.description: Date and time of when the request was authorised by the Institution.

lastConfirmedAt.description: The time that the PSU last confirmed access to their account information, either through full authentication with the institution, or through reconfirmation with the TPP.

reconfirmBy.description: The time by which the consent should be reconfirmed to ensure continued access to the account information.

institutionConsentId.description: Identification of the consent at the Institution.

isDeletedByInstitution.description: Denotes whether the consent has been deleted on the institution side or not when a DELETE method is executed on a Yapily consent if that functionality is provided by the institution
